tax_litigation.status: The Arbitral Tribunal has pronounced the Arbitration Award on January 11, 2026. In case the Respondent fails to pay the said amount within the stipulated period, the Respondent shall be liable to pay future Interest @ 11% p.a. on the awarded amount + accrued interest as on the date of award, from the date of award to the date of actual payment. The arbitration proceedings now stand concluded.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,115.24 Cr (+65.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹21.09 Cr (+226.5% YoY).
PSP Projects presented its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting an order book of ₹13,447 Cr and 66% YoY revenue growth in Q4FY26.
PSP Projects Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on April 30, 2026, discussing audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26.
PSP Projects held Q4FY26 concall, guiding for ₹4,500 Cr revenue in FY27 and expecting to become debt-free.
Prahaladbhai Patel, as Promoter, declared no encumbrance on PSP Projects shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 04, 2026.

watchlist.text: Order Inflow execution and revenue growth

watchlist.response: Company expects no major future ECL provisions as rest of projects are on demand and in control, and interest savings from interest-free advances will boost PAT margins toward 4-5%.
watchlist.text: High ECL provisions hurting net profit margins despite strong revenue growth.
